map.存储卡可拍张数 使用指南: Storage card shot count user guide
map.存储卡可拍张数计算器按容量与单张照片大小（RAW 20-50MB/JPEG 更小: The storage card shot count calculator uses capacity and per-photo size (RAW 20-50MB, JPEG smaller) to estimate the number of shots, for storage planning and preparing cards before shooting.
map.张数 = 容量(GB)×1000 / 单张大小(MB): Shot count = capacity(GB)×1000 / size per shot(MB)
map.按卡容量与单张大小算可拍 RAW/JPEG 张数。: Compute the number of RAW/JPEG shots from card capacity and per-shot size.
map.未压缩 RAW 约 12–30MB、JPEG 高画质 3–10MB，RAW 含全: Uncompressed RAW is about 12-30MB and high quality JPEG 3-10MB; RAW holds all data for better post-processing but takes more space.
map.视频为什么更吃容量？: Why does video use more capacity?
map.视频是连续码流，4K 100Mbps 一分钟约 750MB，远快于单张；延时按帧: Video is a continuous stream, so 4K at 100Mbps is about 750MB per minute, far more than a single photo; time-lapse scales with frame rate.
map.：64GB 卡、RAW 约 25MB/张：张数 = 64×1000÷25 ≈ 2: : 64GB card with RAW about 25MB per shot: shots = 64×1000÷25 ≈ 2560; JPEG at about 8MB → 8000 shots; recording at 10fps stores about 64×1000÷(25×10×60) ≈ 4.3 minutes.
map.：单张 30MB、拍 1000 张需 30GB；14bit RAW 比压缩 JP: : 30MB per shot, 1000 shots needs 30GB; 14-bit RAW is several times larger than compressed JPEG, so estimate peak usage before burst shooting to avoid filling the card.
